<showcaseTemplate>
    <background>…</background>
    <banner>
        <title>…</title>
        <row>
            <button>…</button>
        </row>
    </banner>
    <carousel>
        <section>
            <lockup>…</lockup>
        </section>
    </carousel>
</showcaseTemplate>
```
